security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.longDescription: McMarcel Studio is a local-first desktop application for probabilistic RSV burden and cost-effectiveness modelling. Country evidence, provenance and run artefacts stay on the user's machine.
